content:
The outage was triggered by **CoreDNS overload**.  
In February 2025 the cluster had grown but the CoreDNS Deployment still ran only two replicas. At the evening peak (≈ 19:50 UTC) both CoreDNS pods hit their CPU limits, causing DNS look‑ups to time out across all namespaces. Auth, catalog and orders services all failed because they could not resolve the internal‑dns names they depend on.  

Scaling the CoreDNS Deployment from 2 to 4 replicas at 20:08 UTC cleared the overload and restored name resolution by 20:15 UTC【RB-022#6】. The incident write‑up also notes that “both replicas sat at their CPU limit and lookups began timing out… scaling `coredns` from 2 to 4 replicas… cleared it”【INC-0016#2】.  

Thus, the cascading failure was caused by insufficient CoreDNS capacity (CPU‑bound overload) in the face of increased query volume, which was remedied by adding replicas.  

done.
